headline: Names a post office building in Pacific, Missouri after Specialist Jeffrey L. White, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 324 West Saint Louis Street in Pacific, Missouri. The building will now be called the "Specialist Jeffrey L. White, Jr. Post Office." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 16, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
